derivation.configuration: rigid platform with wind, waves, current, AeroDyn and ServoDyn disabled; HydroDyn and MoorDyn retained
derivation.procedure: temporary diagonal numerical relaxation identified the candidate, followed by a 600 s release with the original HydroDyn damping restored

scope: This artifact supplies only the three initial conditions used by narrow OpenFAST audit scripts. It does not define a full flexible-turbine operating equilibrium or a controller runtime state.
